identity: A lower-primary Arabic mathematics quiz (grade 2-ish): 20 objective items, one per layout line — place value in two-digit numbers, number names in words, components/decomposition of 9, 10 and 11, odd/even, primes, subtraction vocabulary (المطروح / المطروح منه / ناتج الطرح), and divisibility. 15 multiple-choice and 5 true/false (صح/خطأ). Arithmetic operators and equals signs were stripped as punctuation, so embedded expressions survive as bare number runs ('عملية الطرح 70 20 50' = 70 − 20 = 50). Two OCR scars: 'ال' for 'لا' at @54 and @80.
law: §S. [stem ‖ opt ‖ opt …] per line, with a variable option count that this quiz genuinely varies — 3 options in items 1-2, 4 in most, 2 for every true/false. Nothing inside a stem cuts: not the relative clause (item 3, 19), not the coordinating و of '4 عشرات و 2 آحاد' (item 4), not the embedded equation of item 12, not 'ما عدا' (item 10). Number PAIRS that answer a decomposition question are one option each — '3 6' is a single answer, not two — which is A2's 'never cut inside a number-group' generalised to a number-set.
reasoning:
The option grouping is arithmetic, and I verified every item against its own maths so that the split is not a guess:
Item 7 (مكونات العدد 9): 3+6=9 ✓, 3+7=10 ✗, 4+5=9 ✓, 0+9=9 ✓ — the odd one out is the answer to 'لا تعتبر', which confirms the pairs @86-87 / @88-89 / @90-91 / @92-93.
Item 17 (مكونات العدد 10): 2+8 ✓, 6+5 ✗, 6+4 ✓, 5+5 ✓ — same shape, same confirmation.
Item 11 (ناتج جمعها يساوي 16): 9+7=16 ✓ — pairs confirmed.
Item 18 (مجموع عددين أوليين): 3+19=22 with both prime ✓ — pairs confirmed.
Item 12: the stem embeds the whole equation 70 − 20 = 50 because the question is about NAMING one of its members, and the four options are ناتج الطرح / المطروح / المطروح منه / لاشيء مما سبق. 'لاشيء مما سبق' is ONE option — recovered entry 7, doc_5ec52c5c5c0b's 'لا شيء مما ذكر صحيح'.
Item 3 is circle vocabulary, so 'مركز دائرة' is a single two-token term standing beside الدائرة / وتر / قطر, not two options.
The genuinely hard call is items 13 and 14, which are perfectly parallel: 'ما ناتج العملية الحسابية' followed by SEVEN bare numbers each (80 20 10 100 50 30 40 / 20 60 30 50 80 90 70). Either the expression has three operands and there are four options (80−20−10=50 with distractors 100/30/40; 20+60−30=50 with distractors 80/90/70), or it has two operands and there are five options (80+20=100; 20+60=80). Both are arithmetically consistent and each admits exactly one valid operator assignment, so the maths does not decide it. Note that the two readings differ by exactly ONE boundary per item — @183 and @195 — because @184 and @196 are a boundary either way (stem-end under one reading, first-option-end under the other). I cut both, taking the two-operand reading, for three reasons: 'العملية الحسابية' is singular and 80+20 is one operation while 80−20−10 is two; round-tens addition is exactly the skill this place-value quiz drills everywhere else; and the three-operand reading requires BOTH items to answer 50 and to put the answer first, a coincidence that smells like a mis-split. Marked lo — this is the only pair of decisions in the document I would revise on evidence.
Everything else is mechanical, and the check that it is right is that all 19 pre-<NL> tokens plus @287 fall out of the option structure without being forced.
